Aladdin: The Animated Series (1994 to 1995) spotlighted two female villainesses I really like, both sorceresses: Mirage the panther witch and Sareen the mermaid sorceress.

The series ended with A LOT of plots unfinished.

This comic is an epilogue that brings both disclosure both a new start to both Mirage and Sareen, also featuring 3 other prominent villains from the animated series.
